name: quioteframework/quiote
description: Quiote is a full-featured MVC-style framework for PHP 8.5+ with a strong focus on structure, code reusability and flexibility.

suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Install phpunit if you want to run your tests
suggest.ext-xsl: Required only for transformation of pre 1.0 style configuration files
suggest.ext-tokenizer: Enable the tokenizer extension allows Quiote to generate more efficient config-caches
suggest.ext-session: If the session extension is disabled you'll have to build your own session storage system and hook it into quiote
suggest.ext-pdo: PDO is required for database connectors that use PDO as base
suggest.ext-iconv: Enable iconv if you need to convert between other charset than iso-8859-1 and utf-8
suggest.quioteframework/auth: Authentication foundation: form login, HTTP Basic, password hashing, user providers (Quiote\Security\Auth\AuthPlugin)
suggest.quioteframework/auth-jwt: Bearer/JWT resource-server authentication, JWKS, RFC 9068 client-type resolution, built on firebase/php-jwt
suggest.quioteframework/auth-oauth: OAuth 2.1 client (auth-code + PKCE, OIDC) and Client Credentials (M2M), built on league/oauth2-client
suggest.quioteframework/ratelimit: Login throttle / general HTTP rate limiting (Quiote\Security\RateLimit\LoginThrottle, Quiote\Security\RateLimit\RateLimitMiddleware), built on symfony/rate-limiter
suggest.quioteframework/cors: CORS middleware, preflight handling + response headers (Quiote\Security\Cors\CorsPlugin)
suggest.quioteframework/security-headers: Security response headers middleware: CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, etc. (Quiote\Security\Headers\SecurityHeadersPlugin)
suggest.quioteframework/whoops: Full-detail developer exception renderer (Quiote\Exception\Rendering\Whoops\WhoopsRenderer), built on filp/whoops
suggest.quioteframework/telemetry-otel: Install to enable the telemetry.* settings family / OTel SDK exporter (Quiote\Telemetry\TelemetryBootstrap)
suggest.quioteframework/telemetry-dashboard: Install to enable the `telemetry:dashboard` CLI command
suggest.quioteframework/session-pdo: PDO-backed session storage (Quiote\Session\Pdo\PdoSessionPersistence for SessionManager, Quiote\Storage\Pdo\PdoSessionStorage for the legacy Storage subsystem)
suggest.quioteframework/queue: Background job/queue abstraction: job interface, sync driver, retry/dead-letter handling, `queue:work` (Quiote\Queue\QueuePlugin)
suggest.quioteframework/queue-db: Enables the 'db' queue driver, backed by the app's own database (Quiote\Queue\Db\DbQueueDriver)
suggest.quioteframework/queue-redis: Enables the 'redis' queue driver (Quiote\Queue\Redis\RedisQueueDriver), built on predis/predis
suggest.quioteframework/session-redis: Redis session backend (Quiote\Session\Redis\RedisSessionPersistence), built on predis/predis
suggest.quioteframework/scheduler: Cron-expression task scheduling, `schedule:run` (Quiote\Scheduler\SchedulerPlugin), layered on the queue package
suggest.quioteframework/filesystem-s3: Enables the 's3' filesystem disk (Quiote\Filesystem\S3\S3FilesystemPlugin), built on quioteframework/session-s3's S3Client
suggest.quioteframework/filesystem-gcs: Enables the 'gcs' filesystem disk (Quiote\Filesystem\Gcs\GcsFilesystemPlugin), built on quioteframework/session-gcs's GcsClient
suggest.quioteframework/filesystem-azure: Enables the 'azure' filesystem disk (Quiote\Filesystem\Azure\AzureFilesystemPlugin), built on quioteframework/session-azure's AzureBlobClient
suggest.quioteframework/worker-roadrunner: Runs the app as a RoadRunner PSR-7 worker (Quiote\Runtime\RoadRunner\WorkerRoadRunnerPlugin), enabling the 'roadrunner' worker runtime
suggest.predis/predis: Pure-PHP Redis client, enables the 'redis' cache backend (core.cache_backend), the 'redis' queue driver, Redis session persistence, and Redis-backed HTTP rate-limit storage

scripts.test:integration: vendor/bin/phpunit --no-coverage packages/db-eloquent/tests packages/db-doctrine/tests packages/db-cycle/tests packages/queue-redis/tests packages/session-redis/tests packages/ratelimit/tests tests/tests/unit/cache --group integration

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full test suite with APCu disabled (default, deterministic).
scripts-descriptions.test:apcu: Run only the APCu config-cache tests with apc.enable_cli=1.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run the Docker-based end-to-end tests (real OTel Collector + real FrankenPHP). Requires Docker; not run in CI.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the Docker-based integration tests against real DBs and Redis via Testcontainers (Doctrine, Eloquent, Cycle, queue-redis, session-redis, ratelimit, cache). Requires Docker; not run in CI.
